info.title: QR Decoder
info.summary: Read the contents of a QR code from an image URL or base64 data.
info.description: Downloads or decodes the image you point it at, finds the QR code in it and returns the encoded text. Remote images are capped at 8 MB, and URLs that resolve to private or loopback addresses are refused.

get.description: GET is fine for image URLs. When sending base64 data, use POST with the same field names so the payload is not limited by URL length.

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: An `http` or `https` URL of the image, or the base64-encoded image bytes when `format=base64`. A `data:image/...;base64,` prefix is accepted and stripped.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: How `image` should be read. `link` is an alias of `url`.

200.description: On success `data` is the decoded text.

status.description: `200` on success. See status codes below.

data.description: The text encoded in the QR code, or an error message for non-200 statuses.

x-status-codes.title: OK
x-status-codes.description: A code was found and decoded.

x-status-codes.title: Image not usable
x-status-codes.description: The URL was invalid, not `http(s)`, pointed at a private host, exceeded 8 MB, or the base64 payload could not be decoded. `data` says which.

x-status-codes.title: No QR code found
x-status-codes.description: The image loaded but no QR code could be read from it.
